name: com.memphisgamedev.hardening
description: Build-hardening pipeline for shipping Unity games: ship packaging from an allowlist, build hygiene, integrity digests, a per-build watermark, and test-menu/demo build guards. Game-specific values (binary names, environment-variable names, native paths) are configured per project through a HardeningSettings asset. The runtime lives behind the INativeCore and IHardenedSession seams a game implements; see Samples for templates.

samples.description: Reference INativeCore and IHardenedSession implementations (Shop Sim's own adapters) showing how a game registers the seams and drives IntegrityGuard/LanLicence.
The server-side UGS Cloud Code module (challenge, validate, verify-pass, issue-licence) the editor tooling generates and deploys. Excludes generated keys and per-build digests.
The native core C++ source and xollvm build script that back INativeCore. Excludes the generated secret headers and intermediate IR.
